messages:
Alice Nguyen: Heads up — staging rollout for v2.3.1 starts in 30m (15:30 PT). Lane: staging-B. @Ben Torres @Carla Mendez can you both confirm smoke owners?
Ben Torres: I can own smoke verification for routing and latency dashboards. Will be on call. :thumbsup:
Carla Mendez: I’ll cover functional smoke (chat/generation, embeddings). quick run of the smoke harness currently passing locally.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window registered: window_id=wnd-20260317-1530, approver_group=eng-releases, notify=30m.
Daniel Park: Any DB or schema changes in this deploy?
Alice Nguyen: No DB schema changes. Small config toggle for KV cache TTL only (no migration).
Liam O'Connor: Rollback plan ready? Need exact commands in case we need fast revert.
Alice Nguyen: Rollback plan (quick):
```
# scale down new replicas
kubectl -n staging set image deployment/inference-runtime inference-runtime=redwood/runtime:v2.3.0
# if rollout fails
kubectl -n staging rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime
# fallback route
./scripts/set-route.sh --env=staging --target=runtime-v2.3.0
```
Liam O'Connor: 👍 noted. Also flagging that canary traffic split is 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 20m.
Sofia Li: I'll kick off the short load ramp at +10m to validate autoscaler behavior. Will post metrics link when started.
Ben Torres: Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/staging/runtime-latency (will watch p95 and error-rate)
Carla Mendez: Checklist: - [x] unit tests green - [x] e2e smoke locally - [ ] infra ownership ack - [x] deploy config reviewed
Alice Nguyen: Infra ownership acked by @Ben Torres — marking infra item done.
Ben Torres: Infra smoke OK: routing, healthchecks, KV metrics look stable after config toggle. :white_check_mark:
Daniel Park: If we see tokenization regressions, is there an immediate toggle?
Alice Nguyen: Yes — we can switch model variant back to v2.3.0 via the routing flag: `./scripts/pin-model.sh --model=redwood-chat-v2.3.0 --env=staging`
Carla Mendez: Ready to start smoke in 5m. I'll post pass/fail in thread.
Sofia Li: Load ramp starting now. ETA steady state ~3m.
Carla Mendez: Smoke: chat generation ok, embedding sanity checks ok, reranker latencies under threshold. Passing.
Ben Torres: Routing, latency, and error-rate green. p95 < 220ms. Passing.
Alice Nguyen: Great — proceeding with canary push now (10% traffic). Will update at each traffic step.
deploy-bot: Canary step: traffic=10% applied to runtime-v2.3.1 at 1861234685
Liam O'Connor: Observability hooks in place, tracing looks good.
Carla Mendez: Canary 10% OK. Ready for 50%.
Alice Nguyen: Moving to 50% now.
deploy-bot: Canary step: traffic=50% applied to runtime-v2.3.1 at 1861234750
Ben Torres: 50% steady for 5m, metrics stable.
Alice Nguyen: Pushing 100% in 5m unless objections.
Daniel Park: No objections from infra side.
Sofia Li: Autoscaler behaved as expected during ramp.
Alice Nguyen: OK going to 100% now. Will monitor closely for next 15m.
deploy-bot: Canary step: traffic=100% applied to runtime-v2.3.1 at 1861234805
Carla Mendez: Post-deploy quick smoke pass complete. All checks green.
Ben Torres: No elevated errors seen. Rolling monitoring window 15m looks stable.
Alice Nguyen: Thanks everyone — marking deploy complete for staging. Preparing release notes draft and will schedule prod window next week. :tada:
